$comment: T-2.46: which sounds a gun makes. U-020: the roster guns (smg, carbine-scoped, sniper-semi, sniper-bolt-left) borrow an existing gun's report until U-043 gives them their own. Every gun (the loadout's four and the LMG) has a near and a far report; between `crossfade.nearM` and `crossfade.farM` the two are blended at equal power. The handling sounds are shared by every gun; a reload plays `reloadOut` when it starts, `reloadIn` at `stages.in` of the way through and `reloadBolt` at `stages.bolt`.
